turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on there is and there are?
turns.tutor:
Let us look at one picture: one cup, and then two cups. For one cup we say "There is a cup." For two cups we say "There are two cups."
So the rule is: use there is for one thing and there are for more than one thing.
Right: There are two lamps. Wrong: There is two lamps.
Now you try. Complete: "___ three windows in my room."
